title: dsh-delete-conversation configuration
description: Host-side configuration for the conversation deletion plugin. The cordis.patch.yml config layer supplies defaults; higher-priority patch layers may override any field. The Host validates this object at activation (normalizeConfig) because this package intentionally does not depend on a schema runtime.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the route answers 503 and the UI hides its entries.

requireSameOrigin.description: Reject requests whose Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site is not the serving Web GUI.

allowNonLoopback.description: Allow requests when the Web server is bound beyond loopback.

allowOrphanSessions.description: Allow deleting sessions that no registered workspace owns.

allowSubagentSessions.description: Allow deleting sessions whose header origin is 'subagent'.

stopLiveSessions.description: Hard deletion first stops a live session (cancel turn + archive stopActivity + bounded drain). Set false to refuse live sessions instead.

liveDrainMs.description: How long to wait for a live session's turn to settle before failing the deletion.

foreignWriterGraceMs.description: Best-effort guard against a second DSH Host writing the same session log: the newest log mtime is re-checked after this window before a hard delete moves it. 0 disables the guard.

protectedSessionIds.description: Session ids this plugin must never delete, regardless of caller.

allowedWorkspaceRoots.description: When non-empty, a session may only be deleted when its workspace path is inside one of these roots.

defaultMode.description: Initial mode selected in the confirmation dialog.

trashRetentionDays.description: Informational retention shown in the recycle bin; purging is always explicit.

maxBatchSessions.description: Upper bound on one batch. The effective limit is min(this, remaining deletions in the current minute), so a batch can never exceed the rate budget.

maxDeletesPerMinute.description: Sliding-window limit for conversation deletions (single and batch items count individually).

adapters.description: Availability probes run in order; every available adapter contributes counts, so overlapping stores can be detected.

nodesPointer.description: JSON pointer to the node map inside indexFile.

deleteMode.description: trash moves entries into the plugin recycle bin (recoverable); keep only counts and never deletes memory.

showRowAction.description: Show the delete row in the session '…' menu.

showHeaderAction.description: Show the delete icon in the conversation header.
